items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Because at Ryan's when I came back I started working in Ryan's with Wilbur DeParis.

ctx.x: Well then, this tape is going to run out in a minute. But after Europe you've come back to New York and then you work around, it says, Stuyvesant, Casino, Central Plaza, Metropole and then a long time at Ryans etc. And that brings us more or less through doesn't it?
Yes. Because at Ryan's when I came back I started working in Ryan's with Wilbur DeParis.
